ticket.title: CSV export with Overdue status filter contains only the header row
ticket.description: When the invoice list is filtered by status Overdue, Export CSV downloads a file that contains only the header row and no invoices. Exporting without the filter works correctly.

stepsToReproduce: Filter by status Overdue, which shows twelve invoices
bug.actualResult: The file downloads but contains only the header row and no invoices.
bug.expectedResult: A file containing the twelve overdue invoices.

ticket.title: CSV export contains only header row when invoice list is filtered by status overdue
ticket.description: When the invoice list is filtered by status overdue (12 invoices shown), clicking Export CSV downloads a file that contains only the header row and no invoices. Exporting without the filter works fine.

stepsToReproduce: Filter by status overdue, which shows 12 invoices
bug.actualResult: The CSV file downloads but contains only the header row with no invoices.
bug.expectedResult: A CSV file containing the 12 overdue invoices.
